text: Erstwhile means former, describing someone who once held a role or relationship but no longer does. Karen Bass and Nithya Raman were allies before the race, so Ms Raman is her erstwhile ally.
Torpid means sluggish and slow, as if half asleep. The Economist says municipal government is torpid: even replacing a streetlight takes about a year.
Triage began in hospitals, where the most urgent patients are treated first. For a mayor it means sorting many problems by urgency and tackling the pressing ones first.
A Los Angeles city-council member who beat Mayor Karen Bass in the November election. She is a millennial and a member of the Democratic Socialists of America.
The 73-year-old incumbent mayor of Los Angeles, a Democrat and a long-time fixture of the city's politics. She conceded on November 5th.
The Democratic Socialists of America is a US organisation that backs candidates who want a bigger public role in areas like housing and child care, pursued through elections rather than revolution.
A millennial is someone born roughly between the early 1980s and the mid-1990s. Ms Raman is described as one, a younger generation than the 73-year-old mayor she beat.
The elected group that passes a city's laws and budget. Ms Raman served on it for years before running for mayor.
An outdoor amphitheatre in Griffith Park in Los Angeles, usually used for concerts. Ms Raman held her election night party in its courtyard.
A very large public park in Los Angeles, home to the Greek Theatre and the Hollywood sign.
Superstitious people believe certain actions bring good or bad luck. Ms Raman jokes she is superstitious, so she doesn't want to celebrate before the votes are counted.
When election officials release a new batch of counted ballots. In California counting takes days, so each drop can shift the totals, and Ms Raman's lead grew with each one.
To concede is to admit defeat. Ms Bass phoned Ms Raman on November 5th to concede the race.
The incumbent is the person who currently holds an office. Incumbents usually have an advantage, so beating one is notable.
The established group of leaders and insiders who hold power in an organisation. Nearly the entire Democratic establishment backed Ms Bass, which made Ms Raman's win a bigger upset.
To oust is to force someone out of a position. No challenger had ousted an incumbent Los Angeles mayor since 2005.
To view someone unfavourably is to have a negative opinion of them. Nearly two-thirds of polled Angelenos saw Ms Bass this way.
A cardinal sin is a very serious mistake. The phrase comes from religion's list of 'deadly' sins. Here it refers to Ms Bass being abroad when the fires hit.
To incinerate is to burn something completely to ashes. The fires incinerated much of Pacific Palisades.
A wealthy neighbourhood in Los Angeles devastated by a fire in January 2025. It is still being rebuilt.
An idiom for a burden that drags someone down, like a stone tied around a swimmer. Mr Yaroslavsky says the fire and her absence weighed Ms Bass down.
A largely Latino neighbourhood in east Los Angeles. A warehouse fire there drew criticism of Ms Bass's response, and voters in such areas moved to Ms Raman.
To defect is to leave one side and join another. Voters in heavily Latino areas defected from Ms Bass to Ms Raman.
To be reeling is to be badly shaken or stunned, as if staggering after a blow. Voters were reeling from the fires.
Disillusioned means disappointed after discovering something is not as good as you believed. Voters lost faith in the city's response to homelessness.
A billionaire developer who ran for Los Angeles mayor in 2022 on crime and quality-of-life issues. He is a Republican-turned-Democrat.
To veer is to change direction suddenly. Mr Cuevas veered left, meaning he moved from a centrist choice to a left-wing one.
Hard-core means extremely devoted or committed. Mr Cuevas calls his neighbours hard-core DSA, meaning dedicated supporters.
A wonk is someone fascinated by the details of policy. Calling Ms Raman a wonk rather than an ideologue means she cares about how things work.
An ideologue sticks rigidly to a set of political beliefs, even when practical results suffer. The article says Ms Raman is not one.
Incremental means happening in small steps rather than one big change. Her plans favour incremental progress such as faster permits.
The steps for getting government permission to build or film. Making it faster could mean quicker construction of day-care centres and housing.
A structural deficit is when a government spends more than it takes in even in normal times, not just in one bad year.
Money a city pays to settle legal claims that it is responsible for harm or damage. Massive ones strain Los Angeles's budget.
Bloated means swollen beyond what is healthy or needed. A bloated budget is larger than it should be.
To ready something is to prepare it. Ms Raman must ready Los Angeles for the 2028 Olympics.
The private non-profit committee organising the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. If it fails to make money, taxpayers pay for overruns.
To be on the hook means to be responsible for paying or fixing something. Taxpayers are on the hook for any Olympic cost overruns.
When a project costs more than planned. Big building projects like Olympic venues often suffer them.
A financial crisis starting around 2009 when Greece could not repay its government debts. The article says the costly 2004 Athens Games helped trigger it.
A driverless electric train, often short-distance, for moving passengers. LA's airport one has been plagued by delays.
The status quo is the way things currently are. Ms Raman says voters are angry at a broken one.
A do-nothing politician is one who fails to take action. Ms Raman says she won't be that type.
